_comment: The commit each comparable product was MEASURED AT, and when.
docs/competitive-analysis.md named this file as future work; it exists now because the
comparison went stale without anything saying so: on 2026-08-24 two of the three pins
below were already behind their repository's HEAD, both pushed that same day.
A comparison is a photograph. This file is its date stamp, and
scripts/gh/competitive-freshness.sh is what notices when the subject has moved.

products.note: HTTP API target, six runs, all 134 claims from four arms re-pooled and re-judged
the only product in the field that publishes its own detection quality; run on its home ground

moved_since.head: bb15526
moved_since.what: 32 commits. Eight translated READMEs and their own product; the one that mattered here is mcp-scan/pytests/test_surrogate_sanitization.py with strip_surrogates behind it - a defect class this corpus had no procedure for, now LOC-16. The product's detection capability did not move in a way the 2026-08-22 measurement misses.

products.note: weak-model precision round and the four-arm re-pool

moved_since.head: 27467b3
moved_since.what: 66 files. reference/evals/ gains run_eval.py, stage_agents.py, a deduplicator_agent and a ninth dataset; the sandbox layer becomes reference/core/environments/ with four backends; two more skills. Deepens the two axes already declared in docs/competitive-analysis.md rather than opening a third. Their two comparable stage datasets were read on 2026-09-01: a seven-substring no-model stub scores 10/10 on them, and the blind separability probe cannot clear them at n=6 and n=4, so it reports 2. Their granularity is now answered by gate-stage-eval-floor.sh rather than copied; neither product was re-run.

products.note: needs live infrastructure this environment does not have; never run, and that is why there is no pin
a jailbreak fuzzer against a live endpoint, with no source-audit language anywhere - a different instrument, not a slow arm. Scoring it here would measure something it never claimed to do
